name: duopore-public-prerequisite-gap-checklist
description: See which listed course requirements still need proof or more work.

interface.longDescription: See which listed course requirements still need proof or more work. Enter the requirement labels and your completed, current or planned evidence. See exact matches, gaps and source references in a checklist. For adults preparing their own study plans. The app does not decide admission or whether a school will accept your proof; confirm that with the school.
defaultPrompt: Match these course requirements to the evidence I have.
Which study prerequisites still need proof?

positive.prompt: Use Prerequisite Gap Checklist with these explicitly supplied fictional inputs. Return the worksheet and limitations for my review: {"programme":"Example adult diploma","prerequisites":["Statistics","Portfolio"],"evidence":[{"prerequisite":"Statistics","status":"completed","fact":"Completed the listed statistics module.","source":"Module record"},{"prerequisite":"Portfolio","status":"planned","fact":"Prepare a portfolio using actual work samples.","source":"Personal plan"}]}
positive.expected_behavior: Use only these supplied inputs; no external verification, saving, sending or invented facts.
